subject: general
question: As per the Union Budget 2025-26, how many agri-districts will be covered in Phase-I of the Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Budget 2025-26 announced the 'Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme' to boost rural economic development.**
 
• **In Phase-I, the programme will cover 100 developing agri-districts to improve rural employment and agricultural productivity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The programme focuses on creating employment, enterprise development, and financial independence for rural women.
 
• Aims to accelerate new business and job creation for young farmers and rural youth.
 
• Includes modernization of agriculture with improved productivity and warehousing, especially for small and marginal farmers.
 
• Efforts will be made to diversify economic opportunities for landless families.
 
• The first phase will cover 100 developing agri-districts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Union Budget__

 __
 
• A budget is an elaborate statement of the expenditure and income of the government for the given financial year, which begins on April 1 and ends on March 31.
 
• The Constitution uses the term Annual Financial Statement instead of "Budget," as enshrined under Article 112 of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• Agri-Districts__
 __
 
• These are districts where agriculture plays a dominant role in the local economy.
 
• The initiative aims to improve productivity and market access in these areas.
 
 
 
• Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme__
 
 
• Introduced in Union Budget 2025-26 to reduce forced migration and strengthen rural economies.
 
• Encourages enterprise development, employment generation, and agricultural modernization.
